status: accepted as photo-guided exterior candidate; documented estimates retained

observations.front: Five central bays and six principal red columns, three bays per wing, pale end piers, base windows and projecting entry canopy are visible.
observations.oblique: Three roofs and exposed pale-gold/green gable decoration are distinct; south stair bridge and side entrance are visible.
observations.rear: Large pale central masonry wall and small low entry differ from the principal south colonnade.
observations.roof: Three curved hip-and-gable roof groups, raised central gables, ridge details and adjoining hip slopes are visible.
observations.bridge: The transverse road arch, real piers, overhead deck and open balustrade gaps are visible; actual scene rays verify its east-west passage.
observations.side: Central round-arch door, four flanking base windows, two upper glazing bands and projecting open balcony are visible.
observations.porch: Small projecting canopy, slender supports, rearward timber leaves, glazing recesses and original simplified geometric spandrels are visible.

dimension_basis: Photo-informed author estimates and independently mapped source outline, not measured construction drawings.
review_scope: Seven actual Blender renders; geographic/browser integration has separate review records.
